projects.title: A King's Vision
projects.description:
Epidamn, a luxury hospitality brand inspired by the rich history of Durrës, partnered with us to elevate its identity. 

We crafted a cohesive branding strategy, blending modern elegance with elements of sea, sand, and botany to reflect their tranquil, high-end guest experience.

Cubist Elegance

We crafted a unique brand identity that pays homage to the hospitality brand’s storied heritage, weaving together the vibrant spirit of Albanian culture with an eclectic blend of Mediterranean and Moroccan architectural elements. This design vision comes to life through a beautifully curated interior…
